abstract.text: Vendor-neutral analytics for Swift: typed events, tracked by a tracker and delivered in batches to any number of destinations.
Keep each record on disk until it is delivered, so a record the app tracked survives the process ending.
Deliver events to your logs, your traces, a server or memory, and decide what each destination may see.
Give views the tracker the way each framework passes values down, and let modifiers and controls track what views do.
